description.value:
You forbid your foes from benefitting from the divine, using your word as a religious leader. Make a Religion check against the Will DC of a creature within 30 feet: @Check[religion|defense:will].

Critical Success You forbid the creature from drawing on the divine. If it knows any divine spells, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} for 1 minute. If it does not, it takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its saves and AC against divine spells for the duration. (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.effects.Item.SlskvcGUOoN3atxB])

Success As critical success, but stupefied 1 or a -1 penalty. (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.effects.Item.eOu5y1o5i7iEJxiB])

Failure The creature is unaffected.

Critical Failure Others doubt your authority over the divine. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 1} for 1 minute.
